items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Arbitrary Code Execution)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, with attacks starting as early as September 4th, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Customer Account Takeover and other vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update addresses several vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. This flaw allows attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction, and CISA has added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.
